historical_record.description: The Redevelopment Agency conveyed the site, one parcel in the Diamond Heights redevelopment area, to B.R.B. Homes, Inc. for a 44-unit development on 2 August 1976.
By 10 February 1977, the Board of Permit Appeals had denied a permit for a building on the lot, which planning staff had passed although it may not have met the rear-yard rules.

On the City Attorney's opinion that it had no power to review a project conforming to the Diamond Heights redevelopment plan, the City Planning Commission voted 5 to 1 not to take discretionary review of the permit for a 44-unit development on the site, where grading and foundations were already in.
